text:
sasha.design: quick review request 14: posted a compact-frame for the thresholds preview. main issue: suppression capsule and route capsule look too similar at glance. frame: https://img.redwood.local/design/inline_preview_v3.png
ben.pm: thanks. first instinct: change suppression to outline + left accent stripe and keep route filled. that should make the CTA (route) more prominent.
vik.eng: outline approach is fine but beware small themes: 1px outlines vanish in some devices. recommend 2px stroke + a subtle drop layer for depth. also we should expose `tabindex=0` on pills so they are individually tabbable.
anya.sre: keyboard/vo concerns: when the preview updates continuously it generates many VO announcements. do not use `aria-live="assertive"`. prefer `role=status` + `aria-live="polite"` and debounce updates by 300ms. we had regressions before.
jo.content: copy nit: inside tiny pills use verbs: "Route" / "Suppress" not nouns. tooltip: "Routes alerts to selected channels" / "Suppresses alerts for 2 hours" (active voice).
contrastbot: color-pass: deuteranopia check shows filled green + filled gray are still ambiguous in midtones. Outline + accent stripe improved separation. Also recommend a non-color indicator (icon) inside each pill: shield for suppress, arrow for route.
sasha.design: love the icon idea. small layout ask: on very small viewports the callout floats over the action buttons. can we attach the callout above the pill group and make it collapsible? collapsed state should be a single-line summary with chevron.
vik.eng: attach it in DOM right after the pill container so screen readers read it in context. keep a stable container id (preview-id) so we update innerText instead of replacing the element. I'll add `preview_id` to the merged-preview API.
anya.sre: tests: add a QA case that types quickly and asserts only one polite announcement per pause. also test keyboard focus order: Tab into pill group, arrows move between pills, Tab out.
jo.content: empty state rewrite: current "No thresholds set" -> "No alert thresholds yet 1 Create one to start getting notified." CTA label: "Add threshold". also include a help link "How to pick thresholds".
vik.eng: on the API: I'll return { preview_id: "uuid", preview_text: "Suppressed for 2h; affects #ops, #pager", preview_state: "merged" } (we'll keep keys consistent with frontend parsing). We'll debounce server-side recompute to avoid flurries.
contrastbot: accessibility add-on: ensure focus styles don't rely on color. use a 2px outline + 1px inner shadow so it reads on light/dark themes. add `prefers-reduced-motion` CSS support for collapse/expand.
sasha.design: breadcrumb problem: long breadcrumbs push preview down. propose compact crumb pill with overflow menu to save vertical space.
ben.pm: product note: compact crumb makes sense for mobile. keep full breadcrumb for wide layouts. feature flag the compact crumb.
anya.sre: final accessibility checklist: role=status + aria-live=polite, 300ms debounce, stable preview_id, roving tabindex, non-color focus indicator, reduced-motion honored, icons inside pills. I'll add items to QE checklist.
sasha.design: thanks all 1 I'll update Figma with outlined suppress pill + icon + attached collapsible callout and post new frames. tagging @vik.eng @anya.sre for API/QA follow-up.
accessbot: recorded: actions -> outline suppress pill, add icons, attach collapsible callout (DOM order), preview_id in API, aria-live=polite + 300ms debounce, roving tabindex, compact breadcrumb, reduced-motion support.
